descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S21 Pre-round text kept 12 h as a configuration value: the window's source, then 11 h kept / 13 h cleared in both modes, including text left by a failed summary

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 Pre-round text is kept 12 h in both Hospital and Nursing Home, as a configuration value, not hard-coded. (UAT 3.6)
  • U12 Time rules that Save Note touches ('today' on the course line, today's vitals/labs column, the 12 h window) use the server clock; … (UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Part 1: convex/lib/lifecycle.ts at e02167f. Part 2: a saved pre-round in each mode, and one left by a failed summary (edited after the last processing)

When Part 1: read where the 12 h pre-round window (both modes) comes from. Part 2: move the server clock to 11 h and to 13 h after the save and let the lifecycle sweep run

Then Part 1: the window is read from the HOSPITAL_RETENTION / Nursing Home retention config objects, not a literal inside the sweep (3.6 'configuration values, not hard-coded'). Part 2: at 11 h the text is there; at 13 h it is gone in both modes, the failed-summary text included

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Part 1: code read against 3.6, can be done now (doc-review). Part 2: human/backend read at each time point against 3.6. Code read: the hospital rule skips text edited after the last processing (risks)

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94699 in progress

Pre-round text whose structured summary failed is never cleared. It is still on the chart at 13 h and at 100 h in both Hospital and Nursing Home, while normally processed text is cleared at 13 h.

Evidence: allure 831927df: 8 of 19 cells fail. lifecycle.ts clears pre-round text only when preRoundEditedAt <= notesProcessedAt. The lane labels this NEW, but OAT-04 knownGaps K11 already records it (known: TFA-94699 AC 1 / OAT-04 Q2), the unit test 'Hospital never purges unprocessed pre-round dictation' codifies it, and TC-10 risks predicted it. ticket-map says UAT only, so TFA-94699 is listed here through K11. The 100 h cell breaks the 3.7 36 h claim under any reading. Whether the 12 h window covers failed-save text is OAT-04 Q2 (Daniela).

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: CODEREVIEW · Code review; secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S21

Pre-round text kept 12 h as a configuration value: the window's source, then 11 h kept / 13 h cleared in both modes, including text left by a failed summary

Tickets: none (UAT only)

New local lane manual: status failed in manual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: yes): Part 1: code read of convex/lib/lifecycle.ts at e02167f, done inside the spec (test 'part 1' prints the lines). Part 2: api spec, both modes: a saved, processed pre-round (notesProcessedAt = preRoundEditedAt) and a failed-summary pre-round (preRoundError set, notesProcessedAt absent or older than preRoundEditedAt, as useSnfPreRoundProcess / the hospital save write on a failed parse), aged 11 h, 13 h and 100 h (the 100 h cell shows the failed-summary text never ages out); applyLifecycle; read. — Both parts are deterministic: a code read and server reads after aging.

Detail:

11/19 judged cells pass, 1 recorded. Fail: Hospital failed-first-save: text gone at 13 h [U13] | Hospital failed-after-processing: text gone at 13 h [U13] | Hospital failed-first-save: text gone at 100 h [U13] | Hospital failed-after-processing: text gone at 100 h [U13] | Nursing Home failed-first-save: text gone at 13 h [U13] | Nursing Home failed-after-processing: text gone at 13 h [U13] | Nursing Home failed-first-save: text gone at 100 h [U13] | Nursing Home failed-after-processing: text gone at 100 h [U13]. Recorded: Part 1 note: the config objects are module constants = "HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION are constants in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts: lengthening a window is a code change + deploy, not an environ.

Product issue: NEW (U13 has no gate). A pre-round note whose structured summary failed never ages out. The physician saw 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn't be updated' and walked away. At 13 h, and at 100 h (cell added in the re-run), the typed pre-round text is still on the chart, in Hospital and in Nursing Home. This happens whether the first save failed or a re-save failed after an earlier successful one. A text that was processed normally is cleared at 13 h. Cause: the 12 h rule in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts only fires when preRoundEditedAt ≤ notesProcessedAt, and a failed save leaves preRoundEditedAt newer than notesProcessedAt (or notesProcessedAt missing). Breaks UAT 3.6 ('pre-round text … 12 h', both modes) and TC-10's 'including text left by a failed summary'. Part 1 passes: the window comes from HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION, which are code constants.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Part 2 needs the aging helper (shift notesProcessedAt / preRoundEditedAt or the server clock, then run the lifecycle sweep) through the local stack's admin key; dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot be moved, so it stays on the local stack (once the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local code-review] needs a person (partial pass) (code-review/results.json) — code-review: partial → needs a person (partial: the half that can be checked passed, the other half needs another lane / a person / a file → a person looks) Part 1 passes. The 12 h window is set once per mode in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts: HOSPITAL_RETENTION.preRound = 12 * HOUR (line 9) and SNF_RETENTION.preRound = 12 * HOUR (line 31). The sweeps read it from those objects and not from a literal: h…
